_doc: The school's weekly calendar, run by js/systems/director.js. Each entry happens on a weekday (dow 0=Mon … 6=Sun) from 'at' to 'until', optionally only in some weeks ('weeks') or for some students ('who'). place = campus location key where it happens (a waypoint is offered). game = the minigame you can join there (race, dance, football). reward = given when you take part. Random events live in world.json; story arcs in missions.json start from what you do (did:… conditions), not from the date.

events.title: Jumat prayers
events.text: It's Friday — Jumat prayers at the school mosque. The imam's khutbah is short today (he heard about the jollof).

events.title: Inter-house practice
events.text: Inter-house sports practice on the field! Your house needs sprinters. Join a 100m race.

events.title: Visiting Day
events.text: VISITING DAY! Parents are under the trees with coolers of jollof, chicken and provisions. Go and find your people!

events.title: Social Night
events.text: Social Night at the assembly hall — music, dancing, and the famous DANCE BATTLE. Show them what you've got.

events.title: Class captain nominations
events.text: Nominations for class captain are open! Want the job? Go to your class noticeboard and put your name down before Monday.

events.title: Class captain election
events.text: Election day! Your form teacher counts the votes during register.

events.title: INTER-HOUSE SPORTS DAY
events.text: The biggest day of the term! Houses march in, drums everywhere, parents in the stands. Run for your house!
